title: Olivia Rodrigo ‘Over the Moon’ About ‘you seem pretty sad’ Grammy Nods: ‘I Love This Album So Much’
summary: The pop star also said that being nominated alongside Robert Smith is her biggest "pinch-me moment."
contentText:
Olivia Rodrigo is pretty happy for a girl with seven new Grammy nominations. After the Recording Academy unveiled its list of 2027 contenders — which included the pop star in three of the major all-genre categories — the pop star shared her breathless reaction on Instagram .

In her Monday (Nov. 16) post, the singer began, “woke up this morning to 7 Grammy nominations!!!!”

“I am over the moon!!!!!” she continued. “I love this album so much and for it to be recognized in this way is the biggest honor.”

The best part for Rodrigo, she said, was being nominated alongside one of her idols. “I am extra stoked because Robert Smith and I are nominated for two awards together for ‘what’s wrong with me’ which is just the coolest most pinch-me moment I could’ve ever dreamed up,” she added. “Yipeeee.”

Marking her first-ever collaboration, “What’s Wrong With Me” appeared on the Daisy Chain Fields founder’s Billboard 200 -topping third album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love . She and The Cure frontman are up for best rock performance and best rock song thanks to the track, while the LP is in the running for album of the year and best pop vocal album.

Rodrigo also racked up 2027 nominations for both song and record of the year for “The Cure,” as well as best pop vocal performance.

The former Disney star is well acquainted with the Grammys, having previously won best new artist, best pop solo performance for eight-week Billboard Hot 100 -topping single “Drivers License” and best pop vocal album for debut album Sour in 2022.

Next year’s Grammys will take place on Feb. 7. RAYE leads with 11 nominations, followed by Rosalía with nine. Rodrigo is tied for third-most nods with Phoebe Bridgers, Miranda Lambert and Ella Langley.
